preferred_hierarchy: Verified museum/institution scan of exact accession, with appropriate reuse rights
Professional reproduction documented as faithful to museum colour reference
Competent photographic reproduction with manual noise/glare/crop inspection
Website thumbnails only as visual leads, never as authoritative originals
quality_policy.no_fake_approval: A high pixel count, metadata observation or visual check of 512-pixel preview is not a passing result.
quality_policy.no_aesthetic_falsification: Do not colourise, brighten, smooth, reconstruct, relight or paint over genuine original details to flatter app style; preserve artist's tonal values and conservation state.
quality_policy.no_unilateral_crop: Keep a full-frame version; approve phone and desktop focal crops only after original full image has been checked; use letterbox/contain for complex paintings.
quality_policy.quality_not_automated: Image statistic diagnostics can flag issues only; no automated aesthetic scoring of paintings, because craquelure, impasto, aged varnish and tenebrism are real artwork properties.
quality_policy.inspection_at_real_pixels: Review 100% crop of faces, detail zones and background with colour-managed sRGB preview; compare to museum reference where possible.
quality_policy.all_gates: Exact object identity; faithful source; lens/perspective/glare; texture/noise/compression; colour/tonal fidelity; full composition; mobile layout; rights/provenance; checksummed original.

source_quality_findings.finding: Higher-resolution alt photograph with documented 6400 ISO can introduce noise; editorial candidate must be compared at actual pixel detail, not selected by dimensions
Official institutional shot includes frame; prepare independent view of painted field while retaining contextual full altarpiece photograph
Commercial 2428×3852 image exists but paid/restricted; this doesn't satisfy €0 source and may not be ingested
NGA original media URL has been located, but no actual bytes/hash/ICC inspected yet
Official MNAC image identified; present preview offers iconographic confidence, not yet microdetail assurance
